description: This file contains comprehensive tests and usage examples for Lua coroutines, including coroutine creation, resumption, yielding, error handling, metamethods, and debugging features. It explores various edge cases, API functionalities, and internal behaviors of coroutines within the Lua language.

methods.name: coroutine.running
methods.description: Returns the currently running coroutine and a boolean indicating if it is the main thread.

methods.name: coroutine.create
methods.description: Creates a new coroutine with the specified function.

methods.name: coroutine.resume
methods.description: Resumes the execution of a coroutine.

methods.name: coroutine.yield
methods.description: Suspends the execution of the current coroutine.

methods.name: coroutine.status
methods.description: Returns the status of a coroutine ('running', 'suspended', 'dead').

methods.name: coroutine.wrap
methods.description: Creates a callable that wraps around a coroutine for easier resumption.

methods.name: coroutine.close
methods.description: Closes a coroutine, releasing associated resources (Lua 5.4+).

methods.name: coroutine.wrap
methods.description: Creates a function that runs a coroutine.
